units: <cite ref="Yoma 81b:4">Yoma 81ᵇ</cite> <he>כל האוכל ושותה … ת׳ ועשירי</he> whoever eats and drinks on the ninth (of Tishri, being cheerful in his faith in God’s forgiveness) is considered as if he fasted on the ninth and the tenth.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 9:8">Bekh. IX, 8</cite> <he>קרא לת׳ עשירי</he> if (in counting the sheep for tithes) he called the ninth the tenth; a. fr.
